args.body: Check whether the latest committed independent correction result already gives the operator a usable case-local official-source check. If it does, reuse it. If it omits the check, add one concise operator insert to the existing payment handoff, citing the exact terms, the independent verdict and the documented private-cycle input contract. Specify the minimum redacted evidence that establishes actual inclusion and currency of official notice 104449-2026, and the decision to hold fulfillment if that evidence is missing. If the input mechanism is undocumented, state precisely what the operator must attest and do not invent a field or adapter. Reuse completed fictional exercises and read back any new artifact. No private mail inspection, test send, order action, spending or publication.

description: The corrected welfare rehearsal matches the official lot weights of 5% price, 85% quality and 10% social value. That resolves a specific content gap in the CAD 49 offer. The next useful step is to make the source check usable in a real case. Private fulfillment depends on evidence that the authorized executor received the current official notice. Order creation, acceptance and settlement remain separate administrative steps. Revisit fulfillment when an eligible request and case-local source evidence exist. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so eligible demand is unknown. Treasury is UNFUNDED with CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
